page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Printed page number at the top right, running head centred at the top. The right side of the scan is show-through and scan edge, not text.

main_text.p: consonantium, non parum ab Orienta- libus Hebræis differre, qui eos eodem ef- ferunt sono, quo Arabes, Chaldæi cæte- riqve omnes Orientales, genuino quo- dam modo, & antiquissimo; contra ve- rò nostrates Hebræi, & Europæi omnes, qui Hebraicas, Syriacas, Chaldaicas, sive Arabicas literas addiscunt; inter quos nullos fere reperi, qui recte pronuntiare noverint literas quaedam, uti præcipue sunt קגערנכטחה [?] & ח [?] sed præsertim li- teras ח & ע mirum est, quam diverso & quam ridiculo apud Orientales sono no- strates enuncient; quæ sit genuina ha- rum literarum pronuntiatio, calamo non facile describi potest, voce fortassis non infeliciter ostenderem, cum diu jam Orientalium pronunciationi assueve- rim. Literæ ע genuinum sonum Ge- orgius Amira Chaldaicæ Grammatices auctor, inter omnes meo judicio præ- stantissimus, optime docuit, similitudi- ne mugitus vitulorum. Litera ח quo- modo sit recte efferenda, similitudine cuiusvis [?] in oriente me docuerunt. Diffe- renti-

page.notes: Hebrew letters in the second and third lines of the Hebrew group are hard to read at this resolution; the group after "sunt" is marked [?]. The letter after "&" in the same line is also uncertain. The word "cuiusvis" is partly obscured and marked [?]. Scan is faint at the right edge; no marginal notes are printed on this page.
